snippet.title: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Take to the streets to fight against rotten food zombies in Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread. Watch the Gangsta Bean 3 trailer to see gameplay from this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games, as Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies. Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread will be available on PC.
